newsitem.title: GERMANY: German insurer Colonia renamed AXA Colonia.
newsitem.headline: German insurer Colonia renamed AXA Colonia.

text.p: CKAG Colonia Konzern AG, the German holding company controlled by Axa of France, will change its name to Axa Colonia Konzern AG, the company said on Friday.

A formal proposal for the name change will be put to the general meeting on June 10, spokesman Ebrulf Zuber said. Axa gained control over Colonia when in 1996 it took over Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP), the CKAG majority owner.

The company declined to comment on the future names of the group's operative insurers, which so far trade under the Colonia or Nordstern names. "The proposal now on the table only concerns the holding," said Zuber.
